subject.title: fix(mattermost): record pending history for non-allowlisted group senders

question: Should Mattermost groupAllowFrom-denied sender messages be stored as pending prompt history by default, and how must contextVisibility apply to that stored history?
rationale: The patch changes denied sender text from dropped input into model-visible supplemental history, which crosses the documented trigger-authorization versus context-visibility boundary and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Filter Through Context Visibility
options.body: Port the change to current main but store or render denied-sender history only when the configured contextVisibility policy allows that sender's history.

options.title: Approve Trigger-Only Allowlists
options.body: Maintainers can decide that Mattermost groupAllowFrom gates response triggering only and that denied sender history is intentionally visible by default.

options.title: Preserve Current Drop Boundary
options.body: Maintainers can pause or close this PR and keep non-allowlisted Mattermost senders out of pending context until a broader context-visibility design lands.

recommendation.title: Filter Through Context Visibility
recommendation.body: Port the change to current main but store or render denied-sender history only when the configured contextVisibility policy allows that sender's history.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the relevant allowlist hardening and context-visibility contract work that defines this boundary.
